messages:
emma: FYI I noticed the 0.11 draft has mixed SDK examples (old global client + new redwood.infer). I opened PR 527 to standardize.

chris-docs: Thanks. Which files are affected?

emma: whats-new/0.11.md, snippets/gallery/js/generate.md, and migration/cli-to-sdk.md.

dev-bot: snippet-tests INFO  queued for PR 527...

chris-docs: I'll take the JS snippets. Quick rule: prefer `redwood.infer.*` calls and include a one-line shim for legacy callers.

sam: For the migration guide, add a small table mapping CLI flags to SDK params (product asked for it). Keep it under 6 rows.

qa-ali: dev-bot shows a lint warning about frontmatter date format in 0.11 draft. I can patch.

dev-bot: snippet-tests PASS  all gallery snippets OK.

product-bot: Please add a consumer-friendly single-sentence blurb about "adaptive routing" in the relnotes. Provide internal link tag.

emma: Added the mapping table and the single-sentence blurb. Chris, pushed JS fixes.

chris-docs: Merged and pinged QA for preview check.

qa-ali: Preview looks fine. Code blocks render, migration table is legible. Thumbs.

emma: Great  scheduling publish for the release window. Closing thread.
